narrative.overview: The working pages are the same sky the landing opened, seen from the cabin: a pale, still sky band behind solid, opaque panels, under a floating header bar. A flight offer is a boarding pass, never a generic card.
keyCharacteristics: Sky band at the top of every working page, hidden on landing and in print.
Opaque panels with 1px ring and soft panel shadow.
Boarding-pass FlightCard with notch cut-outs and dashed perforation.
Logical layout; directional icons flip in RTL.

rules.name: The Cobalt For Action Rule
rules.body: Cobalt fills mark the thing to press or the thing that is current.

rules.name: The Colour Plus Word Rule
rules.body: Cheapest, peak, scarce and verdict states pair colour with words or an icon.

rules.name: The Numbers Line Up Rule
rules.body: Every price, time, count and date uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Shadow Follows The Cut Rule
rules.body: Masked shapes draw edge and shadow on a wrapper with filter: drop-shadow.

dos: Do use semantic tokens only; pair state colour with words or an icon.
Do put an offer's primary action in the stub at the inline end.
Do keep panels opaque on the sky band.
donts: Don't use cobalt fills for decoration or informational chips.
Don't nest bordered panels inside panels.
Don't use glass, glow, gradient text, side-stripe borders or bounce easing.
